## Activity

During June 2021, Central Eye Clinic recorded 122 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity level should be reviewed alongside image quality and grading outcomes to support routine monitoring of the service. Any operational issues affecting the capture process should continue to be recorded and followed up through the usual local arrangements.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 1 was assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.8 per cent. Although the number of ungradable images was limited, the result should be monitored in subsequent reporting periods. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that equipment-related problems can be identified and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 26 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag between image capture and grading was 2. This measure should be considered with the referable result count when reviewing the timeliness and performance of the service. Local teams should continue to maintain clear records of capture, image assessment and grading activity to support ongoing service oversight.
